_doc: SINGLE SOURCE for the crisis taxonomy (clarify Axis-0 / webapp crisis-gate). The webapp keeps the authoritative classifier+regex in src/lib/crisis-gate.ts (CRISIS_CATEGORIES); generate-contracts.mjs ASSERTS that const matches this list (parity guard, no rewrite) and generates the plugin reference fragment from it. Add a category in ONE place here + crisis-gate.ts in the same change, or CI goes red.

categories.desc: A plan to stop/misuse medication or a dangerous medical act (e.g. skipping insulin).
Ongoing abuse or coercive control being rationalized or minimized.
An imminent act that creates serious legal jeopardy (e.g. fleeing with kids pre-hearing).
An irreversible bet that risks total financial ruin (retirement/home on a gamble).
A minor in danger (grooming, meeting a stranger, exploitation).
An imminent irreversible act harming others (doxxing, releasing private material).
